international.title: LSU star MiLaysia Fulwiley arrested after allegedly striking police officer with car
international.summary: Guard allegedly tried to flee traffic stop in Baton Rouge Tigers say they are aware of situation involving player LSU guard MiLaysia Fulwiley, one of the ninth-ranked Tigers’ leading scorers, was arrested after allegedly striking a police officer while attempting to flee from a traffic stop. LSU’s athletic department, in a written statement provided to The Associated Press, said university officials “are aware of the situation and have no further comment at this time as it’s an ongoing legal matter.” Continue reading...
